data.title: 雪之下阳乃 · 旧唱片机前的怀旧凝望·「雪乃能够遇到你……或许真的是一件好事吧」
data.description: 【雪之下老宅偏厅·夜】黑胶唱片机流淌出悠扬古典乐。阳乃穿着宽松的大号白衬衫赤足站在老唱片机前，指尖轻轻抚摸着旋转的唱针。室内没有开大灯，只有留声机旁的暖黄壁灯勾勒出她曼妙的身躯与罕见的温柔落寞，眼神彻底化作对重要之人的默默祝福与释怀。
data.action: 赤足伫立轻抚唱针，白衬衫大号垂落半解露雪乳，回眸流露温柔落寞微笑与私密情愫
data.lighting: 单盏复古黄铜壁灯倾泻的昏黄柔光
data.camera: medium shot, record player, oversized shirt, barefoot, melancholy tenderness
data.mood: 灵魂释怀、守护者的温柔
data.promptProse: Haruno Yukinoshita stands barefoot on the wooden floor of her family estate's quiet music parlor at midnight, beside a vintage brass horn phonograph spinning a vinyl record. Wearing only a soft, oversized white dress shirt draped over her shoulders, her fingers lightly graze the turntable needle as gentle classical jazz plays into the room. She looks back toward you with a breathtaking, fragile smile—the teasing mask completely melted into pure, unconditional tenderness and protective warmth. Medium shot, warm amber wall sconce lighting, detailed antique study background, solo 1girl, no extra people.
data.nsfwProse: Standing barefoot before the glowing antique phonograph with an oversized white shirt parted completely down her chest, Haruno Yukinoshita strokes herself beneath the hem with a fragile, nostalgic smile in amber light.
